items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 15 September 2026 12:05pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 15 September 2026 at 11:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Complex low developing near Greenland, as another low moves eastwards into Scandinavia. Brief ridge of high pressure builds into Wednesday for a time.


##Wind##

West or northwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 at first.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West, backing southwest, 4 or 5, occasionally decreasing 3 Wednesday afternoon, then increasing 5 or 6 late Wednesday evening or early in the night.


##State of Sea##

Mostly slight Wednesday afternoon, building moderate overnight into Thursday.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then rain spreading from the west on Wednesday evening, clearing overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.
